newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start firm on strong U.S. prices.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start firm on strong U.S. prices.

text.p: European meals and feeds were offered into the cash market at firmer levels on Tuesday but the prospect of another volatile day in Chicago was enough to keep many players here sidelined, traders said.
Two early trades in afloat Argentine sunmeal were noted but soymeal was untraded at around five dollars a tonne higher, and likely to stay firm with Project A trade showing further gains.
"It's just impossible to predict what will happen this afternoon. The dollar is a little lower but that's not enough in itself to spark any big trades," one trader said.
